statement: Under the consistent centered laws, T∗(x) = lims→∞ τs(x) is finite almost surely. For every finite deterministic t and bounded raw Ft-measurable random variable H, E[HGt(x)] = G0(x)E∗ x[H1{t<T∗(x)}]. (2.18) On the right, H is evaluated only on stopped data extending beyond t. Thus EGt(x) = G0(x)P∗ x(T∗ (x) > t) −→ 0 (t → ∞). (2.19) For every stopping time S, E[GS(x)1{S<∞}] ≤ G0(x). (2.20)
